aggregation_repair: Candidate hybrid v5 uses preencode subject crop and all_pairs; official formula is unchanged.
background_support: Binary complement of the designated subject mask, covering every other pixel.
criterion: Also report subject-change response, per-case joint success, missing frames and all time-window controls.
masked_repair: All_pairs, clamped nonnegative cosines; zero uses fixed C(T,2).
other_positions: Quarter-duration start/middle/end are separately reported sensitivity controls, not independent bases.
primary_statistic: Mean absolute paired change; Origin >=0.10 and hybrid v5 repair <=0.01; complete constructed cohort, no score-based filtering.
ratio_interpretation: Background and subject interventions have unequal areas. The former equal-area official-CI-contains-1 criterion is not applicable.
ratio_population: Secondary R: common bases passing subject drop >= 0.05 in every compared column, with all exclusions reported.
rationale: User requested 720 instead of the unstarted 1440 census. Same frozen 2x dose, all quarter/full controls, and unchanged v5. Balanced score-independent selection declared before construction.
sensitivity_gate: clean > subject_corrupt for every backend on the same base
unsupported_denominator: All candidate and constructed denominators retained separately; missing scores are explicit and never counted as successful invariance.
